summary: Honkai entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Honkai: Star Rail
entries.definitive_edition: Current official Windows PC build with server/account/version state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with live servers

primary.why: Honkai: Star Rail is a live, account-based turn-based RPG whose story, events, banners, characters, and systems evolve through patches. PC is the best capture/settings route, but version, server, account, Trailblaze level, and gacha state must be documented.
primary.how_to_play: Use the official PC client or Epic/Hoyoplay route. Record server, version/date, account state, Trailblaze level, story chapter, character roster, event/banners, monetization, platform login, and whether mobile/PS5 were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting platform-specific play or capture.
secondary.why: PC is the cleanest capture/settings route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record version, server, account, roster, banners/events, and monetization state.
